description: Solve right-triangle sides, area and angles.

faqs.a: Leave exactly one of the three boxes empty. The tool solves the missing side; filling all three or only one shows an error.
The hypotenuse must be strictly longer than either leg. If your 'c' is shorter, the inputs are checked and rejected.
faqs.q: Why does it say the hypotenuse must be longest?

faqs.a: With inverse tangent: the acute angles are atan(a/b) and atan(b/a), converted to degrees. The right angle is always 90°.

howto: Enter any two of the three sides: leg a, leg b, hypotenuse c.
Read the missing side, area, perimeter and both acute angles.
title: Pythagorean Theorem Calculator
